name: EXM_SPEND_AUTH_PROCESSING
description: This table contains the processing status for a spend authorization.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTH_PROCESSING_ID
columns.description: Processing identifier of a spend authorization.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTHORIZATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the spend authorization for which status changes are tracked.

columns.name: EVENT_CODE
columns.description: Event that triggered an authorization status change. Possible values are ASSIGNED, COMPLETED, and APPROVE.

columns.name: EVENT_PERFORMER_ID
columns.description: User who initiated the spend authorization status change event.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Spend authorization approval status. Possible values are APPROVED, PENDING MANAGER APPROVAL, and REJECTED.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when spend authorization status change occurred.

columns.name: APPROVAL_LEVEL
columns.description: Order in which approval notification was sent.

columns.name: NOTE_ID
columns.description: Note identifier that resulted from status change.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
